stemMd: A vertical right circular cylinder stands on a horizontal plane. Which pair describes its exact plan and front orthographic silhouettes?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A rectangle in plan and a circle in front

options.label: C
options.textMd: A circle in plan and a rectangle in front

options.label: E
options.textMd: A triangle in front and a circle in plan

explanationMd: The plan looks along the cylinder’s axis and sees its circular cross-section. The front view shows constant width over the height, giving a rectangle. Perspective ellipse conventions are not involved.

distractorRationale.a: This reverses the cylinder’s vertical orientation.
distractorRationale.d: Only the view along the axis is circular.
distractorRationale.b: These are orthographic plan/front views of a vertical axis.
distractorRationale.e: A triangular front silhouette belongs to a cone.
